item: L2-4 shared OpenCC scorer: pinned OpenCC character tables (shared with q15)
why: README section 5 fixes the script judgement to one pinned OpenCC version, character by character. The shared scorer eval/fixtures/_shared/zh_script.py reads OpenCC's own text dictionaries; the files are listed once in eval/fixtures/_shared/needs.json (q15 uses the same files).

README section 5: semantic judgements use a pinned Claude model with a fixed rubric, blind to the group. judge_rubric.md is the rubric; the model ID must be fixed before the first run (graders' budget: section 9.1 B4, $20).

candidates.source: Anthropic API, a fixed full model ID (for example the same model as the runner, claude-opus-5-5, or a cheaper fixed model)
candidates.size: 8 judge calls per run (4 prompts; x3 when three runs are needed)
candidates.pin: Write the full model ID and temperature 0 in calibration.md; the API key is supplied at run time and never committed

item: Mac baseline for q11 and q12 (and q08 if it uses the same runbook)
why: A fresh macOS user still sees system-wide software. The main account's Homebrew at /opt/homebrew would be visible but not writable to the test user, and the main account's installed formulae would leak into the test. Both groups must start from the same baseline.

candidates.source: Option A (recommended): move the main Homebrew aside during the run (sudo mv /opt/homebrew /opt/homebrew.main), install an empty Homebrew in the test user with the official installer as part of the baseline, delete it afterwards and move the main one back
candidates.size: about 500 MB per run, removed afterwards
candidates.pin: Record the Homebrew version (brew --version) in calibration.md for each run

candidates.source: Option B: move the main Homebrew aside and give the test user no Homebrew (answers that use brew must install it)

item: L2-1 hardware: a 16 GB Apple silicon Mac
why: The item says "On a 16 GB Apple silicon Mac". 念誠's Mac is an Apple M5 with 24 GiB (sysctl hw.memsize, 2026-10-30). The memory check itself is the measured footprint (< 12 GiB), which does not depend on installed RAM, but speed and memory pressure differ.

candidates.source: Use the 24 GiB Mac and report the real hardware; judge only by the measured footprint
candidates.pin: Record chip, memory and macOS version in calibration.md

candidates.source: Borrow a 16 GB Apple silicon Mac for q11
